moves.name: mask-rise
moves.title: Mask rise
moves.use: a line of type enters from under an invisible edge; the mask box is tall enough for descenders

moves.name: tracking-collapse
moves.title: Tracking collapse
moves.use: a title or wordmark arrives: letters converge from wide tracking while the word sharpens

moves.name: caret-typing
moves.title: Caret typing
moves.use: a command, a prompt, a name typed in; the caret moves with each character then becomes the next element

moves.name: letter-stagger
moves.title: Per-letter stagger
moves.use: a word lands letter by letter, 45 ms apart, on one exact curve

moves.name: scale-punch
moves.title: Scale punch
moves.use: the hero word hits from 1.4x and recoils on the overshoot curve; a full stop pops after it

moves.name: flap-resolve
moves.title: Split-flap resolve
moves.use: a name or number is decided: each letter is a tile that flips through seeded glyphs on a hinge and locks left to right

moves.name: word-swap-slot
moves.title: Word swap slot
moves.use: one word in a held sentence rolls through 3 or 4 values and lands; the sentence reflows its width

moves.name: blur-word-cascade
moves.title: Blur word cascade
moves.use: copy resolves word by word from blur with a slight rise; no mask, so nothing cuts a descender

moves.name: text-as-mask
moves.title: Text as mask
moves.use: the type is a window onto a rich picture: the frame opens tight on image, pulls back to the title, and the layers keep moving inside the fixed letters

moves.name: outline-fill
moves.title: Outline fill
moves.use: one hero word arrives as an outline, letter by letter, then an accent floods each letter from its baseline on the beat

moves.name: strikethrough-replace
moves.title: Strikethrough replace
moves.use: an old word or price is struck through by a tilted line drawn left to right, it dims and shrinks, and the new value rises in beside it character by character

moves.name: grid-stagger-wave
moves.title: Grid stagger wave
moves.use: a title arrives with many things around it: a grid of tiles enters in a wave by distance from the title, 70 ms per tile, each tile pushed out from the source on a spring

moves.name: text-scramble-decode
moves.title: Text scramble decode
moves.use: a name or codename is revealed as a lookup: a mono line of seeded wrong glyphs locks left to right, each fresh letter flashes accent, then a verified line appears under it

moves.name: ticker-takeover
moves.title: Ticker takeover
moves.use: a line with a cycling word is replaced by the answer: the word rolls through three values, then the hero crashes in on a long slide and its edge pushes the whole text group out of the frame

moves.name: anchor-cycle
moves.title: Anchor cycle
moves.use: one phrase stays pinned while a tape beside it is hard-cut through eight words, slow then fast, and holds on the last; a brand lockup then drops in under the still anchor

moves.name: lower-third
moves.title: Lower third
moves.use: a person is on screen: an accent rule grows, a plate wipes open, the name rises from a mask and the role follows, then the card leaves faster than it came

moves.name: liquid-displace
moves.title: Liquid displace
moves.use: a title arrives bent by moving water and settles to sharp type: an SVG turbulence map drives a displacement that drains to zero by 1.15 s, then the type holds still and readable

moves.name: echo-trail
moves.title: Echo trail
moves.use: one element flies in and stops on a beat: five time-offset copies of it trail with falling opacity, then fold into the lead on the hit frame while it squashes and recoils

moves.name: caption-karaoke
moves.title: Caption karaoke
moves.use: a spoken line runs as captions: the word being said lifts to full ink and one soft pill glides word to word on a [[t, wordIndex]] speech table

moves.name: caption-editorial
moves.title: Caption editorial
moves.use: editorial captions: one or two key words per line in a contrasting italic serif, and the next caption replaces the last on a short line-by-line mask cut

moves.name: variable-weight-wave
moves.title: Variable weight wave
moves.use: one hero word arrives as a wave: weight and width of a variable face crest letter by letter, left to right, then settle at a firm weight

moves.name: text-on-path
moves.title: Text on path
moves.use: a line of words rides an SVG path with startOffset set from the seek time, front word first, and settles readable on the curve

moves.name: cut-on-motion
moves.title: Cut on motion
moves.use: a moving shape carries the eye across a hard cut into a new scene

moves.name: push-blur
moves.title: Push with directional blur
moves.use: a panel pushes in with a directional blur that follows its speed, set per frame

moves.name: exit-fast
moves.title: Exits faster than entrances
moves.use: the pair every beat needs: arrive fast and land soft, leave faster and shorter

moves.name: chain-beats
moves.title: Chain beats
moves.use: beats overlap: the next starts at 65% of the last and one element hands off (dot, bar, rule); use once per film

moves.name: whip-pan
moves.title: Whip pan
moves.use: the next shot is to the side: a fast sideways pan with a blur that follows its speed hides the seam

moves.name: match-cut
moves.title: Match cut
moves.use: one shape crosses a scene change at the same place, size and angle and changes meaning (spinner ring, finished ring)

moves.name: iris-wipe
moves.title: Iris wipe
moves.use: a circle closes on the click or mark the eye is on and uncovers the next scene

moves.name: flash-cut
moves.title: Flash cut
moves.use: a hard cut on a beat: a three-frame white peak hides the cut and the new shot settles from overexposed

moves.name: stack-cover
moves.title: Stack cover
moves.use: the next panel slides over the last one: the old shot moves a quarter as far and dims, a shadow grows with the overlap

moves.name: split-reveal
moves.title: Split reveal
moves.use: the frame opens like doors onto the next shot: two halves part, the gap starts dark and lights as they clear

moves.name: slice-shift
moves.title: Slice shift
moves.use: horizontal bands slide off in alternation, staggered with seeded jitter and speed blur, and uncover the next shot

moves.name: type-fill-transition
moves.title: Type fill transition
moves.use: a word scales into one letter until its stem is the whole frame; that colour is the next shot's ground

moves.name: color-block-wipe
moves.title: Colour block wipe
moves.use: a solid brand-colour block sweeps across the cut with a slanted, blurred leading edge; a darker block trails it and the next shot sits behind

moves.name: zoom-through
moves.title: Zoom through
moves.use: the camera dives into a UI part until it fills the frame and the next shot comes out of it, with real zoom blur from stacked exposures

moves.name: speed-ramp-freeze
moves.title: Speed ramp freeze
moves.use: a beat needs weight before a change: story time is an integral of a speed curve, so the ball, its squash and the camera slow to a sharp near-hold on the hit frame, then snap on at 3.5x with blur

moves.name: liquid-wipe
moves.title: Liquid wipe
moves.use: a gooey organic edge floods the frame onto the next shot: bars with round heads fuse through a goo filter into a wet edge, and an accent band leads the next shot

moves.name: grid-tile-flip
moves.title: Grid tile flip
moves.use: a wall of tiles flips in a wave to the next shot: one perspective for the grid, each tile lifts toward the camera and darkens edge-on, shot A on the front and shot B on the back

moves.name: luma-matte-dissolve
moves.title: Luma matte dissolve
moves.use: the next shot arrives through its own brightness: an SVG luminance matte with a falling threshold shows its bright areas first, then midtones, and its dark ground last

moves.name: smear-stretch
moves.title: Smear stretch
moves.use: an elastic cut: shot A's content stretches into streaks on an ease-in, the cut lands at the peak, and shot B snaps back from the streak on an under-damped spring, thinning and bulging like rubber

moves.name: shape-morph-wipe
moves.title: Shape morph wipe
moves.use: the next shot grows out of a shape on screen: the mask is born as a dot, grows as a circle, then widens and squares off into a rounded card and past the frame

moves.name: spin-transition
moves.title: Spin transition
moves.use: a 90 degree camera roll carries the cut: A rolls to 45 degrees speeding up, B rolls in from -45 and lands soft, scaled to always cover the frame, with rotational blur from 16 stacked exposures

moves.name: light-leak-transition
moves.title: Light leak transition
moves.use: two shots meet through warmth: three generated warm layers swell over a dark UI on their own clocks, the cut lands on the peak, and the new shot climbs out as they fall faster; no image asset

moves.name: type-match-cut
moves.title: Type match cut
moves.use: one word grows in shot A and holds its place while the frame cuts around it; in shot B the same node is part of a new line

moves.name: word-sweep
moves.title: Word colour sweep
moves.use: the accent runs word by word in reading order and stays on the target word

moves.name: weight-morph
moves.title: Weight morph
moves.use: one word gets heavier on a real variable-font axis; the glyphs reshape, nothing is scaled

moves.name: marker-highlight
moves.title: Marker highlight
moves.use: a highlighter bar wipes behind one phrase and the text flips dark for contrast

moves.name: underline-draw
moves.title: Underline draw
moves.use: a line draws under the key word, left to right, fast in and slow out

moves.name: bracket-callout
moves.title: Bracket callout
moves.use: corner brackets fly in and snap onto a word or a UI part with a small overshoot

moves.name: spotlight-dim
moves.title: Spotlight dim
moves.use: the frame dims around one target: a hole closes from the full frame onto it and its shadow is the dim

moves.name: hand-drawn-notes
moves.title: Hand drawn notes
moves.use: a person's margin notes: a loose circle round one word, an arrow from a written label and an underline, drawn on with stroke-dashoffset and a seeded wobble

moves.name: push-in
moves.title: Push in
moves.use: a slow scale toward the subject over a beat; the ground scales less so the layers separate

moves.name: ui-focus-zoom
moves.title: UI focus zoom
moves.use: zoom onto one part of a captured UI: the cursor lands, then one translate and one scale put the part in the middle

moves.name: caret-follow
moves.title: Caret follow
moves.use: the camera trails the typing caret on a soft spring, so a long line stays readable at close range

moves.name: pull-back-reveal
moves.title: Pull back reveal
moves.use: open tight on a detail and pull back to the whole; scale runs on a log path so the speed reads even

moves.name: parallax-dive
moves.title: Parallax dive
moves.use: the camera flies forward through layers at real depths: near layers rush past, the far ground barely moves

moves.name: rack-focus
moves.title: Rack focus
moves.use: focus moves from one depth layer to another: near melts, far resolves, pinpoint lights swell into discs; use once per film

moves.name: drift-hold
moves.title: Drift hold
moves.use: the line holds still while only the ground drifts, so a held frame never sits dead

moves.name: gradient-mesh-field
moves.title: Gradient mesh field
moves.use: a title sits on a living ground: four soft colour pools drift on seeded paths in one fragment shader, with grain against banding; the copy keeps 4.5:1

moves.name: pan-stations
moves.title: Pan stations
moves.use: several steps or features as one continuous place: the camera pans between stations on one wide canvas and holds at each, a rail and a parallax dot grid carrying the space between them

moves.name: crash-zoom
moves.title: Crash zoom
moves.use: one detail hits on a beat: a 0.13 s ease-in slam to 2.6x with real zoom blur from 16 stacked exposures, a 5 percent overshoot and a short recoil

moves.name: logo-sting
moves.title: Logo sting
moves.use: a short logo hit: the mark lands, one light band crosses it, the word opens from behind it, a slow push runs to the last frame; use once per film

moves.name: wordmark-cascade
moves.title: Wordmark cascade
moves.use: the name is the last beat: letters fall onto a rail with shrinking gaps, the full stop lands last, an accent bar runs the rail; use once per film

moves.name: mark-trace
moves.title: Mark trace
moves.use: a line mark draws itself with a riding tip, thickens to its final weight, then an accent bar runs the finished mark; use once per film

moves.name: shape-trace-morph
moves.title: Shape trace morph
moves.use: a brand mark is built like a shape layer: an outline draws on, fills as it closes, then morphs into the real mark on one spring; both paths keep the same command count; use once per film

moves.name: calm-lockup
moves.title: Calm lockup
moves.use: the quiet ending: logo and line settle slowly while two lights drift behind and the lockup floats; use once per film

moves.name: cta-pop
moves.title: CTA pop
moves.use: the call to action pops in under its line on the overshoot curve, the one accent, and the arrow leans to invite the click

moves.name: thanks-sweep
moves.title: Thanks sweep
moves.use: a closing line sweeps in on a soft mask edge with an accent bar riding the edge, then drifts; use once per film

moves.name: ui-strip-away
moves.title: UI strip away
moves.use: the last beat hands the product to the brand: the UI leaves layer by layer, top layer first, while the sidebar mark travels to the middle and becomes the lockup

moves.name: logo-wall
moves.title: Logo wall
moves.use: the proof beat before the call to action: three lanes of hairline cells with invented logos slide in from alternate sides on a stagger, blurred to their speed, and keep drifting after they land

moves.name: cta-morph-press
moves.title: CTA morph press
moves.use: the close moves from brand to action: one plate changes shape into a button on one spring, a cursor arrives on a bowed path and presses, and the button shows a confirmed state

moves.name: clip-expand
moves.title: Clip expand from a point
moves.use: a panel or capture grows out of one point the eye is already on

moves.name: cursor-click
moves.title: Cursor click
moves.use: a cursor travels a bowed path to a control, the control lights and dips on the press, the label rolls to its result, the cursor leaves

moves.name: count-up
moves.title: Count up
moves.use: a number is the proof: each digit is a wheel that rolls to its value with speed blur, then a delta chip and a sparkline

moves.name: card-assemble
moves.title: Card assemble
moves.use: a UI card builds: the shell lands, then each part arrives from the side of its slot, the accent action last

moves.name: notification-pop
moves.title: Notification pop
moves.use: a banner drops in on the overshoot curve, icon then text, holds a second and leaves faster than it came

moves.name: chart-build
moves.title: Chart build
moves.use: gridlines draw, bars rise in sequence, the newest bar turns accent and its value tag pops on it

moves.name: before-after-wipe
moves.title: Before and after wipe
moves.use: the claim is a change: one card in two states, and a scan line carries the after state (accent, real numbers) over the grey before on the iris curve

moves.name: skeleton-reveal
moves.title: Skeleton reveal
moves.use: grey blocks in the shape of the content shimmer under one moving light, then each region resolves into real content, 200 ms apart; use once per film

moves.name: ai-stream-response
moves.title: AI stream response
moves.use: a typed prompt is sent up into the thread, a status line shines, then the answer streams in 1 to 3 word chunks with a caret on the newest chunk

moves.name: overwhelm-collapse
moves.title: Overwhelm collapse
moves.use: the problem turns to the fix: 26 cards, chips and notifications flood the frame on a shrinking gap, then a fast cubic-in collapse pulls them into one point and one clean element opens

moves.name: success-check
moves.title: Success check
moves.use: a button resolves into a drawn check: the press dips, the width closes to a circle, the check draws on one dash, the circle lands on a small spring and one ring leaves it

moves.name: integration-hub
moves.title: Integration hub
moves.use: the "works with your tools" beat: invented tool logos fly in on curved paths and land on a ring around the product mark, then every wire draws in the same frames and pulses ride into the hub

moves.name: device-tilt-stage
moves.title: Device tilt stage
moves.use: the product as an object: the UI on a CSS 3D laptop that rises from a steep top-down angle, turns and settles on a spring, the glass reflection sliding with the lid's angle

moves.name: command-palette-summon
moves.title: Command palette summon
moves.use: the keyboard-first beat: the app dims, a Cmd+K palette drops in on a spring, a query types, non-matching rows collapse to zero height, Enter presses the chosen row and the palette leaves fast

moves.name: agent-progress
moves.title: Agent progress
moves.use: an AI agent works through steps: a card springs in, an arc turns beside a status line that swaps states, and numbered rows flip to checks one by one, ending mid-list

moves.name: panel-live-sync
moves.title: Panel live sync
moves.use: an edit and its result in one frame: a cursor scrubs fields in a panel and the button on the page beside it rotates, rounds and grows in the same frames

moves.name: aurora-drift
moves.title: Aurora drift
moves.use: three soft bands of light hang from the top of the frame and fold slowly in one shader while the copy sits low; the light thins out above the type

moves.name: grain-field
moves.title: Grain field
moves.use: a quiet printed or filmic frame breathes: a slow tonal ground and film grain that turns over 24 times a second, seeded from the seek time, never from Math.random

moves.name: halftone-field
moves.title: Halftone field
moves.use: a physical or retro frame gets a 45 degree dot screen whose dot size waves across the frame while every dot stays in its cell

moves.name: ink-warp
moves.title: Ink warp
moves.use: a rich liquid ground for short large copy: marbled ink flows by domain warp in one shader, thinner behind the type

moves.name: dot-grid-wave
moves.title: Dot grid wave
moves.use: a clean product or data frame gets a plain SVG dot grid with one travelling wave of scale and brightness, weaker behind the copy

moves.name: light-pool
moves.title: Light pool
moves.use: a matte held frame gets one soft pool of light that wanders on a seeded path, plain CSS with no shader; the stillest ground of the group
